### What each switch controls

Choose which movement suits the task before adding gestures or changing moods.
Turning panel movement off still leaves the panels available.

| Switch | What you see move |
|--------|-------------------|
| `idle` | The resting character breathes and blinks. |
| `mood_change` | A wiggle or hop accompanies a new mood. |
| `gestures` | The character performs a nod, wave or another gesture. |
| `swap` | One character changes into another. |
| `minimising` | The mascot travels to its round restore button. |
| `restoring` | The mascot returns from its restore button. |
| `messages` | Animation of the bubble, tooltip and menu. |
| `others` | Movement whose switch is left at `NULL`, including future switches. |

### Which setting wins

A visitor who requests reduced motion keeps that preference even when a switch
is enabled. Otherwise, an explicit named switch takes priority; a switch left at
`NULL` uses `others`.

```{r mascot_motion_settings-precedence, echo = FALSE}
guide_flow(
  guide_step("Visitor requests reduced motion", htmltools::div("overrides enabled movement")),
  guide_step("Named switch", htmltools::div("TRUE or FALSE; messages also accepts panel names")),
  guide_step("others", htmltools::div("used when the switch is NULL"))
)
```

### Three motion recipes

```r
mascot::mascot("helper", motion = FALSE)
```

Result: movement is off, with reduced-motion poses and instant drag transitions.

```r
mascot::mascot("helper", motion = mascot::mascot_motion_settings(idle = FALSE))
```

Result: resting breathing and blinking are off; the other switches follow the
default `others = TRUE`, subject to the visitor's reduced-motion preference.

```r
mascot::mascot("helper", motion = mascot::mascot_motion_settings(others = FALSE, gestures = TRUE))
```

Result: only gestures are enabled; the other switches follow `others = FALSE`.
The helper sets permission to move; it does not start a gesture.

```{r mascot_motion_settings-check-recipes, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
still <- mascot::mascot("helper", motion = FALSE)
no_idle <- mascot::mascot_motion_settings(idle = FALSE)
gestures_only <- mascot::mascot_motion_settings(others = FALSE, gestures = TRUE)
```

### A calm dashboard

Create the dashboard helper with the gestures-only recipe above. In a server
observer, acknowledge an action with a nod:

```r
mascot::update_mascot("helper", gesture = "nod")
```

Mood, bubble and status updates still work when their movement is disabled.
A reduced-motion preference can suppress the nod too.
